body:
# **APXTPA - Advanced Teleport Request Plugin**
APXTPA is a modern and lightweight teleport request plugin designed for Minecraft servers. It provides a complete teleportation system with support for both Java Edition and Bedrock Edition players, making cross-platform gameplay smooth and user-friendly.

The plugin includes teleport requests, teleport-here requests, automatic teleport preferences, multilingual support, GUI-based request management, cooldown systems, safety checks, and economy integration support.

# **Features**

✅ Cross-platform support (Java & Bedrock Players)

✅ /tpa teleport requests

✅ /tpahere teleport-here requests

✅ /tpaccept request acceptance

✅ /tpdeny request denial

✅ /tpcancel request cancellation

✅ /tpatoggle request blocking

✅ /tpauto automatic request acceptance toggle

✅ GUI-based request management

✅ Bedrock-friendly forms and interfaces

✅ Multi-language support

✅ Customizable messages and settings

✅ Teleport countdown system

✅ Movement cancel protection

✅ Fly-mode detection and protection

✅ Teleport cooldowns

✅ Request expiration system

✅ Economy support via Vault

✅ EssentialsX compatibility

✅ Permission-based access control

✅ Configurable sounds and effects

✅ Lightweight and optimized performance

# **Safety Features**

Prevents teleportation while players are flying.
Teleport requests automatically expire after a configurable time.
Cancels teleports when players move during countdown.
Supports request blocking and automatic acceptance settings.
Includes cooldowns to prevent spam.

#**Dependencies (Optional)**
Vault – Economy support
EssentialsX – Enhanced compatibility
Geyser – Bedrock player support
Floodgate – Bedrock account support

# **Commands**
Command	Description
/tpa <player>	Send a teleport request
/tpahere <player>	Request a player to teleport to you
/tpaccept	Accept a request
/tpdeny	Deny a request
/tpcancel	Cancel a pending request
/tpatoggle	Toggle incoming requests
/tpauto	Toggle automatic acceptance
/apxtpa reload	Reload plugin configuration

# **Permissions**

apxtpa.tpa
apxtpa.tpahere
apxtpa.accept
apxtpa.deny
apxtpa.cancel
apxtpa.toggle
apxtpa.tpauto
apxtpa.reload
apxtpa.admin
